# `/multihosts` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /multihosts/v1

`createMultiHostIntegrationV1` — Create multi-host integration

This API is used to create Multi-Host Integration. Multi-host Integration holds similar types of sources. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:manage
- Body (application/json): multihostintegrationscreate
- Returns 201: multihostintegrations

### GET /multihosts/v1

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:read
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…

  - `for-subadmin` (query) — If provided, filters the returned list according to what is visible to the indicated ROLE_SUBADMIN Identity or SOURCE_SUBADMIN identity. The value of the parameter is either an Identity ID, or the…
- Returns 200: array of multihostintegrations

### GET /multihosts/v1/types

`getMultihostIntegrationTypesV1` — List multi-host integration types

This API endpoint returns the current list of supported Multi-Host Integration types. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:read
- Returns 200: array of multihostintegrationtemplatetype

### POST /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}

`createSourcesWithinMultiHostV1` — Create sources within multi-host integration

This API is used to create sources within Multi-Host Integration. Multi-Host Integration holds similar types of sources. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:manage
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration.
- Body (application/json): array of multihostintegrationscreatesources
- Returns 200: no body

### GET /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}

`getMultiHostIntegrationsV1` — Get multi-host integration by id

Get an existing Multi-Host Integration. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Integration Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:read
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration.
- Returns 200: multihostintegrations

### DELETE /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}

`deleteMultiHostV1` — Delete multi-host integration

Delete an existing Multi-Host Integration by ID. A token with Org Admin or Multi Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:manage
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of Multi-Host Integration to delete.
- Returns 200: no body

### PATCH /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}

`updateMultiHostSourcesV1` — Update multi-host integration

Update existing sources within Multi-Host Integration. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration to update.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 200: no body

### POST /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}/sources/testConnection

`testConnectionMultiHostSourcesV1` — Test configuration for multi-host integration

This endpoint performs a more detailed validation of the Multi-Host Integration's configuration. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration
- Returns 200: no body

### GET /multihosts/v1/{multihostId}/sources/{sourceId}/testConnection

`testSourceConnectionMultihostV1` — Test configuration for multi-host integration's single source

This endpoint performs a more detailed validation of the source's configuration. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:read
- Parameters:
  - `multihostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration
  - `sourceId` (path, required) — ID of the source within the Multi-Host Integration
- Returns 200: object

### GET /multihosts/v1/{multiHostId}/sources/errors

`getMultiHostSourceCreationErrorsV1` — List multi-host source creation errors

Get a list of sources creation errors within Multi-Host Integration ID. A token with Org Admin or Multi-Host Admin authority is required to access this endpoint.

  - `multiHostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration

### POST /multihosts/v1/{multiHostId}/sources/bulk-delete

`deleteMultiHostSourcesV1` — Delete sources within multi-host integration

This endpoint performs bulk sources delete within Multi-Host Integration via a list of supplied IDs. The following rights are required to access this endpoint: idn:multihosts:delete, idn:sources:delete

- Scopes: idn:multihosts-admin:manage, idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, MULTIHOSTS_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `multiHostId` (path, required) — ID of the Multi-Host Integration
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 200: no body
